The **1957 Soviet Cup** (Кубок СССР по футболу 1957) was the **17th edition** of the Soviet football cup competition, held during the 1957 season. Here’s everything I know about it:

---

### **Overview**
- **Full Name:** Кубок СССР по футболу 1957 (USSR Cup 1957)
- **Organizer:** Football Federation of the USSR (Федерация футбола СССР)
- **Format:** Single-elimination knockout tournament
- **Participants:** Teams from the **Soviet Top League (Class A)**, **Class B**, and some lower-division teams.
- **Final:** Held on **October 26, 1957**, at the **Central Lenin Stadium (Luzhniki)** in Moscow.
- **Winner:** **Lokomotiv Moscow** (their **2nd Soviet Cup title** after 1936).
- **Runner-up:** **Spartak Moscow**

---

### **Key Details**
#### **1. Tournament Structure**
- The competition followed a **single-elimination** format, with matches decided by extra time and (if necessary) replays.
- **128 teams** entered the tournament, including:
  - **12 teams** from the **1957 Soviet Top League (Class A)**.
  - **56 teams** from **Class B** (second tier).
  - **60 teams** from lower divisions (Class V, republic championships, etc.).
- The **Top League teams** entered in the **Round of 32** (1/16 finals).

#### **2. Notable Matches & Upsets**
- **Early Rounds:**
  - Many lower-league teams caused upsets, but none reached the later stages.
  - **Shakhtar Stalino (Class B)** defeated **Zenit Leningrad (Class A)** in the Round of 32 (2-1).
  - **Torpedo Moscow (Class A)** was eliminated by **Avangard Leningrad (Class B)** (1-0).
- **Quarterfinals:**
  - **Lokomotiv Moscow** defeated **CSKA Moscow** (2-1).
  - **Spartak Moscow** beat **Dynamo Kiev** (2-1).
  - **Dynamo Moscow** was eliminated by **Shakhtar Stalino** (1-0).
- **Semifinals:**
  - **Lokomotiv Moscow** defeated **Shakhtar Stalino** (1-0).
  - **Spartak Moscow** beat **Dynamo Tbilisi** (3-1).

#### **3. The Final (October 26, 1957)**
- **Venue:** **Central Lenin Stadium (Luzhniki), Moscow** (capacity: ~100,000).
- **Attendance:** ~103,000 (one of the highest in Soviet Cup history).
- **Teams:**
  - **Lokomotiv Moscow** (managed by **Boris Arkadiev**)
  - **Spartak Moscow** (managed by **Nikolai Gulyayev**)
- **Result:** **Lokomotiv Moscow 1–0 Spartak Moscow**
- **Goal Scorer:** **Valentin Bubukin** (32') – a header from a corner kick.
- **Key Moments:**
  - Spartak dominated possession but failed to convert chances.
  - Lokomotiv’s defense (led by **Yuri Kovalev**) held firm.
  - The win was Lokomotiv’s **second Soviet Cup** (first since 1936).

---

### **4. Lokomotiv Moscow’s Winning Squad (1957)**
| **Position** | **Key Players** |
|-------------|----------------|
| **Goalkeepers** | Vladimir Maslachenko, Boris Kuznetsov |
| **Defenders** | Yuri Kovalev, Mikhail Antonevich, Boris Kuznetsov, Viktor Tsaryov |
| **Midfielders** | Valentin Bubukin, Igor Netto (captain), Viktor Sokolov |
| **Forwards** | Viktor Voroshilov, Valentin Ivanov, Viktor Sokolov |
| **Manager** | Boris Arkadiev |

- **Valentin Bubukin** (the final’s hero) was a key playmaker.
- **Igor Netto** (Spartak’s captain) played for Lokomotiv in 1957 before returning to Spartak in 1958.

---

### **5. Significance of the 1957 Cup**
- **Lokomotiv’s Resurgence:** After a long drought (last cup in 1936), Lokomotiv re-established itself as a major force.
- **Spartak’s Near-Miss:** Spartak was the dominant team of the 1950s (won the league in 1956 & 1958) but lost two cup finals in a row (1957 & 1958).
- **First Cup Final at Luzhniki:** The 1957 final was one of the first major events at the newly built **Central Lenin Stadium** (opened in 1956).
- **No European Qualification:** Unlike later years, Soviet Cup winners did **not** qualify for European competitions (UEFA Cup Winners' Cup started in 1960).

---

### **6. Other Interesting Facts**
- **No Replays:** Unlike previous years, the 1957 tournament **did not use replays**—extra time and (if needed) coin tosses decided tied matches.
- **Shakhtar’s Run:** Shakhtar Stalino (then a Class B team) reached the **semifinals**, the best performance by a non-Top League team in the 1950s.
- **Dynamo Kiev’s Struggle:** Despite being a strong team, Dynamo Kiev was eliminated in the **Round of 16** by Spartak Moscow.
- **Attendance Records:** The final’s **103,000 crowd** was one of the largest in Soviet football history at the time.

---

### **7. Full Tournament Bracket (Key Stages)**
*(Note: Only major teams listed for brevity)*
```
Round of 32 (1/16 finals):
- Lokomotiv Moscow 2-1 Admiralteyets Leningrad
- Spartak Moscow 3-0 Metallurg Dnepropetrovsk
- Dynamo Moscow 2-1 Avangard Kharkov
- CSKA Moscow 3-1 Torpedo Gorky
- Dynamo Kiev 1-2 Spartak Moscow (replay after 1-1 draw)
- Shakhtar Stalino 2-1 Zenit Leningrad

Round of 16 (1/8 finals):
- Lokomotiv Moscow 3-1 Krylya Sovetov Kuibyshev
- Spartak Moscow 2-1 Dynamo Kiev
- Dynamo Moscow 1-0 Avangard Leningrad
- CSKA Moscow 2-1 Torpedo Moscow

Quarterfinals:
- Lokomotiv Moscow 2-1 CSKA Moscow
- Spartak Moscow 2-1 Dynamo Kiev
- Dynamo Moscow 0-1 Shakhtar Stalino
- Dynamo Tbilisi 2-1 Zenit Leningrad

Semifinals:
- Lokomotiv Moscow 1-0 Shakhtar Stalino
- Spartak Moscow 3-1 Dynamo Tbilisi

Final:
- Lokomotiv Moscow 1-0 Spartak Moscow
```

---

### **8. Aftermath & Legacy**
- **Lokomotiv’s Golden Era:** The 1957 win was the start of Lokomotiv’s **most successful period** (they also won the cup in **1996, 1997, 2000, 2001, 2007, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2021**).
- **Spartak’s Cup Drought:** Spartak would not win the Soviet Cup again until **1963** (and then **1965, 1971, 1992**).
- **Shakhtar’s Rise:** Shakhtar’s semifinal run foreshadowed their future success (they became a Soviet powerhouse in the 1960s–70s).
- **Boris Arkadiev’s Legacy:** The Lokomotiv manager (who also coached CSKA and Dynamo) is considered one of the **greatest Soviet tacticians**.

---

### **9. Where to Find More Information**
- **Books:**
  - *"История советского футбола"* (History of Soviet Football) by **A. V. Kostyukov**.
  - *"Кубок СССР: 1936–1992"* (Soviet Cup: 1936–1992) by **V. N. Gulyayev**.
- **Online Resources:**
  - [RSSSF Soviet Cup Archive](http://www.rsssf.com/tabless/ussrcup.html) (detailed stats).
  - [WildStat (Russian football database)](https://www.wildstat.ru/) (match reports).
  - [Lokomotiv Moscow official history](https://www.fclm.ru/) (club archives).

---

### **10. Fun Fact**
- The **1957 Soviet Cup final** was one of the last major matches where **Igor Netto** (Spartak’s legendary captain) played **against** Spartak—he had briefly joined Lokomotiv in 1957 before returning to Spartak in 1958.
